title: v2.17 ships an AWS Global Accelerator controller behind the GlobalAcceleratorController feature gate — new CRD, IAM policy and RBAC when enabled

detection.reason: checked the controller Deployment's --feature-gates for GlobalAcceleratorController=true — the only switch (there is no --enable-global-accelerator flag; an unknown flag stops the controller at start); off, nothing of this applies

quote: Feature Flag for Global Accelerator - Enable the feature flag `--enable-global-accelerator=true,--feature-gates=EnableRGTAPI` to use Accelerator functionality
remediation: Only when enabling it: apply config/crd/aga/aga.k8s.aws_globalaccelerators.yaml, docs/install/aga_controller_iam_policy.json and the latest config/rbac/role.yaml, then pass --feature-gates=GlobalAcceleratorController=true,EnableRGTAPI=true (the chart's controllerConfig.featureGates). There is no --enable-global-accelerator flag.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image? // "" | test("aws-load-balancer-controller")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image) args=\(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].args // [] | join(" "))"'  # the controller Deployment, its image tag and every flag it runs with
coversNotes: v2.17.0: CRD Updates - If you're upgrading the charts using helm upgrade, you need to update CRD
v2.17.0: IAM Policy Updates - Update the controller's IAM policy with Global Accelerator permiss
v2.17.0: RBAC Updates - Apply the latest RBAC definitions for Global Accelerator controller perm

title: The 2.15/2.16 feature gate AGAController is renamed GlobalAcceleratorController in 2.17 — the old name is an unknown gate and the controller refuses to start

detection.reason: checked the controller Deployment's --feature-gates for the pre-2.17 gate name AGAController — 2.17 parses it as 'unknown feature' and exits

remediation: Rename AGAController to GlobalAcceleratorController in --feature-gates (controllerConfig.featureGates) in the same change as the 2.17 upgrade; a 2.17 controller started with AGAController=... logs 'unknown feature' and crash-loops.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image? // "" | test("aws-load-balancer-controller")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image) args=\(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].args // [] | join(" "))"'  # the controller Deployment, its image tag and every flag it runs with
